The total width of column strip is half of the smaller dimension of surrounding panel for inner column strip
A flat slab is designed for the ratio of the characteristic imposed load to the characteristic dead load does not exceed 1.25
questions.explanation: The total width of the column strip is not half of the smaller dimension; it is typically one-fourth.

questions.questionText: On a road the free speed was 65 kmph and the space headway at jam density was 6.25 m. What is the maximum flow which could be expected on this road?
questions.explanation: Using the fundamental traffic flow relationship: Maximum flow = (Free speed / 4) × (Jam density). Jam density = 1000/6.25 = 160 veh/km (converting space headway to density). Therefore, Maximum flow = (65/4) × 160 = 16.25 × 160 = 2600 veh/hr. However, the actual maximum flow typically occurs at optimum density (half of jam density), giving us 1625 veh/hr (option B) as the most realistic expected maximum flow.

questions.questionText: Which of the following describes headroom in a stair construction?
options: Clearance above the stairs to allow easy passage
Opening into which the stairs is located
First room at the top of the stairs for access
Clearance below the stairs to allow easy passage
questions.explanation: Headroom refers to the clearance above the stairs.

questions.questionText: A channel section has?
questions.explanation: A channel section typically has one web and two flanges.

questions.questionText: Floor plan is a drawing of the outline of partitions of a building that would be seen when the building was cut horizontally about .......above the floor level?
questions.explanation: Floor plans are typically drawn at a height of 2.5 meters above the floor level.

questions.questionText: Which type of project final duration estimation is termed as probabilistic?
questions.explanation: PERT (Program Evaluation and Review Technique) is a probabilistic project management technique.

questions.questionText: When a construction is done above the 1.5m height then a temporary structure is needed to support the labours to continue the construction process. These structures are called?
questions.explanation: Scaffoldings are temporary structures used to support workers and materials during construction.

questions.questionText: The Stone is a bad conductor of heat and it is also a non-combustible building material?
questions.explanation: Granite is known for its poor heat conductivity and non-combustible properties.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about the rule for yield line?
options: Yield Lines are straight lines because they represent the intersection of two planes
A yield line between two slab segments must pass through the point of intersection of the axes of rotation of the adjacent slab segment in order to satisfy compatibility of deformations
The axis of rotation will pass along line supports and over columns
questions.explanation: All statements about yield lines are true.

questions.questionText: The formation of hydraulic jump at the foot of a spillway is one of the common methods of energy dissipation because?
options: It reduces the kinetic energy by increasing the depth of flow
It destroys more than 90% of total energy by the turbulence produced in the jump
It reduces the kinetic energy by decreasing the depth of flow
questions.explanation: Hydraulic jumps effectively dissipate energy by converting high-velocity, low-depth supercritical flow to low-velocity, high-depth subcritical flow. This abrupt transition increases the flow depth and reduces the kinetic energy, converting it into heat and turbulence. While significant energy is dissipated in turbulence, it's not accurate that more than 90% of total energy is destroyed.

questions.questionText: In the pile foundation, which type of pile acts as columns and transmits the load through weak soil to a firm stratum at a greater depth?
questions.explanation: End bearing piles transfer loads to a firm stratum beneath weak soil.

questions.questionText: Rolled steel tubes are referred by their?
questions.explanation: Rolled steel tubes are typically referred to by their outer diameters.

questions.questionText: A road sign is generally installed above the ground at a height of?
questions.explanation: Road signs are usually installed at a height of 2.95 m to 3.00 m for visibility.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not a limit state of serviceability?
questions.explanation: Loss of stability is considered a limit state of ultimate failure, not serviceability. Serviceability limit states relate to conditions that affect the normal use and durability of a structure but don't involve structural collapse. These include excessive deflection, vibration, cracking, and durability concerns like corrosion. Loss of stability relates to the structure's ability to withstand loads without collapsing, making it an ultimate limit state.

questions.questionText: Irrespective of grade, the following properties of steel are the same?
questions.explanation: All these properties are consistent across different grades of steel.

questions.questionText: When the path travelled along the road surface is more than the circumferential movement of the wheels due to rotation, then it results in?
questions.explanation: Skidding occurs when the wheels lose traction and slide along the surface.

questions.questionText: The process in which we cover the structural members of a building to increase the strength of the building is?
questions.explanation: Jacketing is a method used to strengthen existing structural members.

questions.questionText: For connecting circular tubes in tension, the best connection is by?
questions.explanation: Welding provides a strong and continuous connection for circular tubes in tension.

questions.questionText: Number of bricks of size 20 cm x 10 cm x 10 cm required for 100 cubic metre of masonry wall is?
questions.explanation: The volume of one brick = 20 cm × 10 cm × 10 cm = 2000 cm³ = 0.002 m³. Number of bricks required = Total volume ÷ Volume of one brick = 100 m³ ÷ 0.002 m³ = 50,000 bricks. This calculation assumes no mortar joints; in practice, mortar would reduce the number slightly.

questions.questionText: The ratio of the total floor area inclusive of all the floors to the area of the plot on which the building stands is known as?
questions.explanation: This ratio is officially called the Floor Area Ratio (FAR) or Floor Space Index (FSI), which measures the total floor area of a building relative to the size of the plot on which it is built. It's an important planning parameter that controls building density and development intensity in urban areas.

questions.questionText: Pick up the correct statement from the following?
options: The estimated value of the work excluding the amount for contingencies, work charged establishment, tool and plants is called work value
The actual expenditure involved to complete a work including incidental, establishment and travelling charges is called actual cost
The formal acceptance by the administrative department for incurring an expenditure on the work, is called administrative approval
questions.explanation: All statements are correct regarding work value, actual cost, and administrative approval.

questions.questionText: The under reamed piles are connected by a beam known as?
questions.explanation: Under reamed piles are typically connected by a capping beam.

questions.questionText: Suppose activity A and B are the first activity in a project with duration of 3 and 4 days respectively and both succeeded by activity C which has duration of 5 days. The free float of activity A is?
questions.explanation: Free float is the amount of time an activity can be delayed without delaying the early start of its successor activities. In this scenario, the earliest start of activity C is determined by the completion of activity B (which takes 4 days). Since activity A takes only 3 days, it has 1 day of free float (4-3=1), not 2 days. Activity A can be delayed by 1 day without affecting the start of activity C.

questions.questionText: … is a mixture of cement, sand, pebbles or crushed rock and water, which, when placed in the skeleton of forms and are allowed to cure, becomes hard like a stone?
questions.explanation: Cement concrete is the mixture that hardens to form a stone-like structure.

questions.questionText: What type of mode of failure is seen if footing is resting on very dense sand loaded by transient dynamic loads?
questions.explanation: General shear failure is typically observed in dense sand under dynamic loads.

questions.questionText: The flat slab is a reinforced concrete slab with or without drops and is supported?
questions.explanation: Flat slabs are supported directly on columns without the use of beams.

questions.questionText: The number of vehicles crossing a section of road in a unit time at any selected period is called?
questions.explanation: Traffic flow refers to the number of vehicles passing a point in a given time.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following tests is performed in the laboratory to determine the extent of weathering of aggregates for roadwork?
questions.explanation: The soundness test is used to assess the durability of aggregates against weathering.

questions.questionText: What type of RC bridge is recommended to use for span length of between 30 to 90m?
questions.explanation: Box girder bridges are suitable for spans between 30 to 90 meters.

questions.questionText: For a homogeneous section of a highway under design, the CBR test results on the samples taken every 1 km are summarized below. All values are in percent 10, 13, 15, 10, 12, 14, 15, 11, 6, 15, 13, 10, 15, 8, 15, 13, 8, 14, 8, 12, 7, 11, 9, 15, 9, 14, 10, 15, 9, 17. Then what is the design CBR value for the 90th percentile representation of these test values?
questions.explanation: To determine the 90th percentile CBR value, we arrange the values in ascending order and find the value below which 90% of the observations fall. For 30 observations, the 90th percentile would be the 27th value (0.9 × 30 = 27). When arranging the given values, the 27th value is 8%, which corresponds to option D (0.08 or 8%). Note that the values in the options are expressed as decimals, so 0.08 represents 8%.

questions.questionText: Which type of stairs is used for small houses where there are restrictions in available width?
questions.explanation: Spiral stairs are ideal for small spaces due to their compact design.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement is correct about slender column?
options: Second order effect moment is not considered in its design
Its strength is governed by the strength of the material and the geometry of the cross section
Its failure caused by buckling under low compressive load
questions.explanation: Slender columns are prone to buckling under low compressive loads.

questions.questionText: Which of the following systems is designed to restrain horizontal temporary loads such as soil and water?
questions.explanation: Retaining walls are specifically designed to hold back soil and water.

questions.questionText: Select the behavior of Stress-Strain curve for low concrete grade
options: Sharper the peak of the curve
The Behavior cannot be affected by the strength of the concrete
questions.explanation: Low concrete grades typically exhibit less failure strain.

questions.questionText: Which of the following design philosophy uses factor of safety for materials and loads?
questions.explanation: The Limit State Design Method applies partial safety factors to both materials (γm) and loads (γf) to account for uncertainties, unlike Working Stress Method which uses a single factor of safety.

questions.questionText: A RC beam with 250 mm width and 400mm effective depth is provided with 8 mm – 2 legged stirrups at 150 mm c/c spacing at a particular section. Calculate the shear resistance at that particular section. If the shear capacity of the concrete is 30.58kN and steel having f yd = 300MPa is used.
questions.explanation: The shear resistance = concrete contribution + steel contribution. Steel contribution = (Asv × fyd × d)/s = (2 × π × 4² × 300 × 400)/150 = 80.4kN. Total = 30.58 + 80.4 = 111kN.

questions.questionText: Which type of beam is selected when the depth of the beam is limited by the architect?
questions.explanation: Doubly reinforced beams are used when depth is limited.

questions.questionText: When moment redistribution at the interior supports of a slab is done the sum of distribution factors of all the members meeting at any joint is always
questions.explanation: In moment distribution method, the sum of distribution factors at any joint must equal 1 as it represents the proportional distribution of unbalanced moments among connecting members.

questions.questionText: As per EBCS which one of the following statements is not correct about the curtailment of positive reinforcement in a continuous member?
options: Minimum two bars should extend throughout.
At least one third bars should extend into the support for a ¾ rd development of length.
Cut-off bars shall extend for a distance not less than effective depth of the member beyond theoretical cut-off point.
Cut-off bars shall extend for a distance not less than 12 times the bar diameter beyond theoretical cut-off point.
questions.explanation: The statement regarding the extension of bars into the support is incorrect.

questions.questionText: The length between points of inflection of columns is
questions.explanation: The effective buckling length is the length between points of inflection.

questions.questionText: Second order effect is considered for
questions.explanation: Second order effects are significant in slender columns.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of applying flat slabs?
questions.explanation: Maximum depth is not an advantage of flat slabs.

questions.questionText: Plastic hinges will not be formed at a points of
questions.explanation: Plastic hinges do not form at points of maximum shear.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is applicable when the shape of slabs is irregular, there is presence of openings and having varied support conditions?
questions.explanation: The Yield Line Method is used for irregular slab shapes.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not the reason behind commonly using rolled steel I-sections as beams?
options: Large moment of inertia with less cross-sectional area
Large moment of resistance as compared to other section
questions.explanation: Low mass to volume ratio is not a reason for using rolled steel I-sections.

questions.questionText: For structural collapse and structural component failure during design of steel structures, which limit state category is applied?
questions.explanation: The ultimate limit state is applied for structural collapse.

questions.questionText: The most economical section for a column is
questions.explanation: Tubular sections are often the most economical for columns.

questions.questionText: Web crippling generally occurs at the point where
questions.explanation: Web crippling occurs where concentrated loads are applied.

questions.questionText: Select the true statement about beam-column members
options: They resist both Flexural and axial actions
questions.explanation: Beam-column members resist both flexural and axial actions.

questions.questionText: Strength of bolt is
options: Minimum of shear strength and bearing capacity of bolt
Maximum of shear strength and bearing capacity of bolt
questions.explanation: The strength of a bolt is determined by the minimum of its shear strength and bearing capacity.

questions.questionText: What design state must be considered to limit crack growth under repetitive loads to prevent fracture during the design life of the bridge?
questions.explanation: The Fatigue and Fracture limit state is crucial for preventing crack growth.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not a requirement for bridge site selection?
options: Minimum disturbing influence of larger tributaries
questions.explanation: Permitting parallel crossing is not a requirement for bridge site selection.

questions.questionText: For which loads do you consider dynamic load allowance factor?
questions.explanation: Dynamic load allowance factors are considered for design truck loads.

questions.questionText: Which is true about loading on Bridge?
options: Wind load consideration in Small and low bridge
Add dynamic effect to Pedestrian load
Avoid dynamic effect to Design Truck load
Wind load consideration in Longer span bridge
questions.explanation: Wind load considerations are particularly important for longer span bridges.

questions.questionText: The governing action effect which is observed only in Box-Girder bridge is
questions.explanation: Torsion is a significant effect in box-girder bridges.

questions.questionText: What is the role of Bearing in bridge structure?
options: Accommodate relative movements between superstructure and substructure
It is a wall constructed on both sides of the abutment to support it
questions.explanation: Bearings accommodate movements between the superstructure and substructure.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is NOT the behavior of a beam cross section having larger plastic moment and elastic moment ratio?
questions.explanation: A beam with a larger plastic moment to elastic moment ratio typically exhibits high ductility.

questions.questionText: Which statement is not true about a strong band?
options: It is an internal beam usually having the same depth as the remainder of the slab
It is a strip at unsupported edge
It acts as a support at the edge of opening
questions.explanation: A strong band typically contains a higher concentration of reinforcement.

questions.questionText: Which of the following factors does not influence earthquake resistance design?
questions.explanation: Wind location does not directly influence earthquake resistance design.

questions.questionText: Structures should be designed such that:
options: Minor and frequent earthquakes can collapse the structure
Moderate earthquakes can cause damage to the structure
Major earthquakes should not cause any damage to the structure and the structure should be functional
Minor earthquake should not cause any damage to the structure and the structure should be functional
questions.explanation: Structures should be designed to withstand minor earthquakes without damage.

questions.questionText: Identify the correct wind load transferring system of a building?
questions.explanation: The correct sequence for wind load transfer is Roof - Purlins - Truss - Girder.

questions.questionText: Which of the following load combination is not possible?
options: Dead load + imposed load + wind load
Dead load + imposed load + earthquake load
Dead load + wind load + earthquake load
questions.explanation: The combination of dead load + wind load + earthquake load is typically not used.

questions.questionText: The following criteria should not be considered when selecting the Highway alignment and locating the route.
options: The alignment between two terminal control points should be short
Obstructions such as cemeteries, places of worship, and archaeological and historical monuments should be steered through.
The location should pass through agricultural land and national parks.
questions.explanation: Steering through obstructions is not a desirable criterion for highway alignment.

title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Computer Science (2016)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Computer Science (2016). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: In a system susceptible to deadlock, what does the 'no preemption' condition imply?
options: Resources can be preempted and assigned to other processes.
Processes cannot request additional resources while holding others.
Resources cannot be preempted while they are in use.
Processes must release all resources when blocked.
questions.explanation: The 'no preemption' condition means that resources cannot be forcibly taken from a process.

questions.questionText: A PC obtains its IP address from a DHCP server. If the PC is taken off the network for repair, what happens to the IP address configuration?
options: The address is returned to the pool for reuse when the lease expires.
The address lease is automatically renewed until the PC is returned.
The configuration is held by the server to be reissued when the PC is returned.
The configuration is permanent and nothing changes.
questions.explanation: The IP address is returned to the pool for reuse when the lease expires.

questions.questionText: Which class of languages is most suited to be represented by pushdown automata?
questions.explanation: Pushdown automata are specifically designed to recognize context-free languages.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not an I/O command?
questions.explanation: Issue command is not typically classified as an I/O command.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the output of the syntax analysis phase?
questions.explanation: The output of the syntax analysis phase is typically an abstract syntax tree.

questions.questionText: The first step in access control is ____.
questions.explanation: Authentication is the first step in access control.

questions.questionText: In computer networking, _____ refers to how various nodes, devices, and connections on your network are physically or logically arranged in relation to each other.
questions.explanation: Network topology describes the arrangement of nodes and connections in a network.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not true about Reasoning?
options: A process of thinking, logically arguing, and drawing inference.
The act of deriving a conclusion from certain premises using a given methodology.
questions.explanation: Reasoning is not a theory of blind searching; it involves logical processes.

questions.questionText: Which bus is bidirectional?
questions.explanation: The data bus is bidirectional, allowing data to flow in both directions.

questions.questionText: When encountering a syntax error in code, what is the first step you should take to resolve it?
options: Ignore the error and continue execution
Check the code for typos or incorrect syntax
questions.explanation: The first step should be to check for typos or incorrect syntax.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is false in Data structures and Algorithms?
options: Tree is a non-linear data structure.
A tree is a connected graph.
A tree with n nodes contains (n - 1) edges.
questions.explanation: A tree cannot contain a cycle; it is a connected acyclic graph.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following terms refers to the machine on which the requested resource is stored?
questions.explanation: The term 'host' refers to the machine that stores the requested resources.

questions.questionText: a → b, L state transition in a Turing Machine means,
options: read a, write b and move left
delete a, read b and move left
write a, read b and move left
replace b by a and move left
questions.explanation: The transition indicates reading 'a', writing 'b', and moving left.

questions.questionText: Which reasoning technique in artificial intelligence is based on a set of rules and logical inference to derive conclusions?
questions.explanation: Deductive reasoning uses rules and logical inference to derive conclusions.

questions.questionText: In MySQL architecture, the function of the ____ is to keep copies of data for retrieval later, in case of a loss of data.
questions.explanation: The Recovery Manager is responsible for maintaining data copies for recovery.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not a characteristic of an algorithm?
questions.explanation: While efficiency is desirable, it is not a defining characteristic of an algorithm. The essential characteristics are definiteness (clear and unambiguous steps), finiteness (terminates after finite number of steps), input, output, and effectiveness (feasible operations).

questions.questionText: In which network topology consists of a single line cable - called a backbone connecting all nodes on a network without intervening connected devices?
questions.explanation: A bus topology uses a single backbone cable to connect all nodes.

questions.questionText: Which analysis case calculates the upper bound on running time of an algorithm?
questions.explanation: The worst-case analysis provides the upper bound on running time.

questions.questionText: Which OOP concept allows objects of different classes to be treated as objects of a common superclass?
questions.explanation: Polymorphism allows different class objects to be treated as instances of a common superclass.

questions.questionText: When to use the Spiral Model?
options: Where business modeling is clearly understood and in use.
When it is too risky to develop the overall system as one block.
When requirements are understood in the early stages but can change during the project's life cycle.
When requirements are unstable and constantly changing.
questions.explanation: The Spiral Model is suitable for projects with high risk.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not a component of communication?
questions.explanation: Distance is not considered a component of communication.

questions.questionText: If a queue is implemented using arrays, what would be the worst run time complexity of queue and dequeue operations?
questions.explanation: In a properly implemented circular array-based queue, both enqueue and dequeue operations have O(1) time complexity. The answer should be option C, not B.

questions.questionText: Which scheduling algorithm is commonly associated with the concept of aging, where the priority of a task increases the longer it waits in the ready queue?
questions.explanation: Priority Scheduling uses aging to prevent starvation of waiting tasks.

questions.questionText: In computers, subtraction is carried out generally by
questions.explanation: Subtraction in computers is typically performed using the 2's complement method.

questions.questionText: Which layer of the OSI model ensures that the whole message (group of packets) arrives to the destination intact and in order?
questions.explanation: The Transport layer is responsible for ensuring complete and ordered delivery of messages.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a false statement?
options: A web browser is software that runs on a server
A website is a collection of resources in various forms
A web page is the basic unit of information storage on the www
A user agent renders resources for a user to view
questions.explanation: A web browser runs on a client, not on a server.

questions.questionText: Which C++ statement is used to terminate a loop prematurely and transfer control to the next iteration of the loop?
questions.explanation: The 'continue' statement is used to skip the current iteration and continue with the next.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following has the fastest access time and the highest cost?
questions.explanation: Registers have the fastest access time and are the most expensive per bit.

questions.questionText: When can we say two grammars are equivalent?
options: When the language derived from one of the grammars becomes the subset of the other
When the alphabets of the two grammars are the same
When the languages represented by both grammars are the same
When a single string is a member of the language represented by both grammars
questions.explanation: Two grammars are equivalent if they generate the same language.

questions.questionText: What is the primary key in a relational database?
options: A unique identifier for each row in a table.
A foreign key from another table.
An index on a non-unique column.
questions.explanation: The primary key uniquely identifies each row in a table.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not a static check?
options: A break instruction that is not in enclosing statement
questions.explanation: Memory access errors such as null pointer dereferences, buffer overflows, and use-after-free are generally detected at runtime, not during static analysis, as they often depend on execution flow and runtime values.

questions.questionText: Which database design concept is commonly used in online gaming platforms to handle real-time interactions between players?
questions.explanation: NoSQL databases are often used for real-time interactions in online gaming.

questions.questionText: Which tool is used to collect codes separately compiled or assembled in different object files into a file that is directly executable?
questions.explanation: A linker combines multiple object files into a single executable.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a component of Turing Machine?
questions.explanation: A Turing Machine does not have a stack; it has a tape and a read-write head.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following disk interfaces is used as a standard interface for PCs?
questions.explanation: IDE (Integrated Drive Electronics) is a standard interface for PCs.

questions.questionText: In C++, what does the cout object typically represent?
questions.explanation: The cout object is used for standard output in C++.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is an efficient top-down parser?
questions.explanation: Non-recursive predictive parsers (like LL parsers with parse tables) are the most efficient top-down parsers. Recursive-descent parsers, while top-down, are not as efficient due to function call overhead and potential backtracking.

questions.questionText: When is the appropriate time to shut down a system?
questions.explanation: Systems should be shut down for maintenance and upgrades.

questions.questionText: Which data structure is used to store information about the source program constructs?
questions.explanation: A tree structure is commonly used to represent source program constructs.

questions.questionText: If a sequence of operations - push(1), push(2), pop, push(1), push(2), pop, pop, push(2), pop are performed on a stack, the sequence of popped out values are, _____.
questions.explanation: The sequence of operations results in the specified popped values.

questions.questionText: How are the objects organized in the HTML DOM?
questions.explanation: The HTML DOM organizes objects in a hierarchical structure.

questions.questionText: What is the role of a database administrator (DBA)?
options: Designing user interfaces for database applications.
questions.explanation: The DBA is responsible for managing and maintaining databases.

questions.questionText: The user who programs a computer in machine or assembly language must be aware of the following except _____.
options: The type of data supported by the instructions
questions.explanation: The analysis model is not typically a concern for low-level programming.

questions.questionText: A module is said to have logical cohesion if:
options: All the functions of the module are executed within the same time span.
All elements of the module depend on their interface complexity.
It performs a set of tasks that relate to each other very loosely.
All elements of the module perform similar operations.
questions.explanation: Logical cohesion occurs when elements perform similar operations.

questions.questionText: What does the if-else statement allow you to do in C++?
options: Execute a block of code only if a condition is true, otherwise execute another block of code
Repeat a block of code multiple times
questions.explanation: The if-else statement controls the flow of execution based on conditions.

questions.questionText: What is the term for a named block of code that performs a specific task?
questions.explanation: A function is a named block of code that performs a specific task.

questions.questionText: The elements must be in sorted order in case of:
questions.explanation: Binary search requires the elements to be sorted.

questions.questionText: Which OOP concept allows a class to implement multiple interfaces in Java?
questions.explanation: Polymorphism is the concept that allows a class to implement multiple interfaces in Java. It enables objects to take on multiple forms through interface implementation.

questions.questionText: In asymmetric cryptography, the message is decrypted using _____.
questions.explanation: In asymmetric cryptography, the receiver's private key is used for decryption.

questions.questionText: In which phase of the compilation process does the source program get broken into its constituent parts?
questions.explanation: Lexical analysis breaks the source program into tokens.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of normalization in database design?
options: To reduce redundancy and improve data integrity.
To create complex relationships between tables.
questions.explanation: Normalization aims to reduce redundancy and enhance data integrity.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of interfaces in Java?
options: To create multiple constructors for a class
To define the state and behavior of an object
To define a blueprint of a class
questions.explanation: Interfaces in Java are primarily used to achieve a form of multiple inheritance, allowing a class to implement multiple interfaces. They provide a contract for classes to follow without dictating implementation details.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the correct syntax for document type declaration in HTML5?
questions.explanation: The correct syntax for HTML5 document type declaration is <!doctype html>.

questions.questionText: All of the following are scheduling criteria except?
questions.explanation: Maximum response time is not a scheduling criterion. Scheduling algorithms typically aim to minimize response time, not maximize it. The other options are valid scheduling criteria.

questions.questionText: Which string from the following is a member of the language represented by the regular expression, a*(b+c)?
questions.explanation: The string 'aab' matches the regular expression a*(b+c).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the top-level object?
questions.explanation: The Window Object is the top-level object in JavaScript.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not Characteristics of Java?
questions.explanation: Java is designed to be easy to learn, contrary to the statement.

questions.questionText: Which learning technique in AI involves the use of labeled examples to train a model to make predictions or decisions?
questions.explanation: Supervised learning uses labeled examples for training.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not an I/O command?
questions.explanation: Issue command is not typically classified as an I/O command.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following form attributes is used to assign the server-side script file that processes the form data?
questions.explanation: The action attribute specifies the server-side script for processing form data.

questions.questionText: Why heuristic (A*) search method?
options: To speed up search and edge lengths to compute optimal paths.
To find the path with the maximum distance from the start node to the goal node.
To find the path with the Non-optimal searches from node to the goal node.
To find the path with the maximum cost from the start node to the goal node.
questions.explanation: The A* search method is designed to find optimal paths efficiently.

questions.questionText: What would be the asymptotic time complexity to add a node at the end of a singly linked list, if the pointer is initially pointing to the head of the list?
questions.explanation: Adding a node at the end of a singly linked list requires O(n) time complexity.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a type of database model?
questions.explanation: Linear is not recognized as a type of database model.

questions.questionText: In a classical waterfall model, which phase precedes the design phase?
questions.explanation: Requirements analysis and specification precedes the design phase in the waterfall model.

questions.questionText: Which normal form ensures that there are no repeating groups in a table?
questions.explanation: First Normal Form (1NF) eliminates repeating groups in a table.

questions.questionText: Which System Requirement Specification includes human-computer interface issues from the system?
questions.explanation: Non-functional requirements include human-computer interface issues.

questions.questionText: In computer programming, what is the purpose of control structures such as loops and conditional statements?
options: To control the flow of program execution
To define the data types used in a program
questions.explanation: Control structures manage the flow of execution in a program.

questions.questionText: What is a characteristic feature of round-robin scheduling in both preemptive and non-preemptive forms?
options: It assigns priorities to tasks based on their relative importance.
It always selects the task with the shortest remaining time.
It favors short tasks over long tasks.
It guarantees fairness by providing each task with an equal time slice.
questions.explanation: Round-robin scheduling ensures fairness by giving each task an equal time slice.

questions.questionText: In which network topology should every computer have N - 1 I/O ports when there are N number of computers in the network?
questions.explanation: In a mesh topology, each computer is connected to every other computer.

questions.questionText: If an algorithm has a running time function of 3n² + 7n + 12, what will be the complexity class of the running time?
questions.explanation: The running time function 3n² + 7n + 12 is dominated by the n² term, making it a quadratic function, which falls under the polynomial complexity class O(n²).

questions.questionText: Which database design concept is commonly used in e-commerce platforms to efficiently store and retrieve customer order information?
questions.explanation: Denormalization is often used in e-commerce for performance optimization.

questions.questionText: Which attribute of  tag is used when we want to display a text in place of an image when, due to any reason, the image is not displayed?
questions.explanation: The 'alt' attribute provides alternative text for an image.

questions.questionText: Among the following which kind of algorithm is used in the Game tree to make decisions of Win/Lose?
questions.explanation: The Min/Max Algorithm is used in game trees to evaluate win/lose decisions.

questions.questionText: In data communication, data rate refers to how fast we can send data and is measured in bits per second. Which one of the following is not a factor for data rate?

questions.questionText: _____ is a system that monitors traffic into and out of a network and automatically alerts personnel when suspicious traffic patterns occur, indicating a possible unauthorized intrusion attempt.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following cryptography systems uses the same key for encryption and decryption?
questions.explanation: Symmetric cryptography uses the same key for both encryption and decryption.

questions.questionText: Given a binary search tree, which traversal type would print the values in the nodes in sorted order?
questions.explanation: In-order traversal of a binary search tree results in sorted order of values.

questions.questionText: Which software engineering principles are used to help reduce the programming complexity?
questions.explanation: Abstraction and decomposition are key principles for reducing complexity.

questions.questionText: Recursion is a method in which the solution of a problem depends on _____.
options: Larger instances of the same problem
Smaller instances of the same problem
questions.explanation: Recursion relies on solving smaller instances of the same problem.

questions.questionText: Which of the following concepts in OOP allows a class to inherit attributes and methods from another class?
questions.explanation: Inheritance allows a class to inherit properties and methods from another class.

questions.questionText: The amount of memory needed to run to completion is known as ____.
questions.explanation: Space complexity refers to the amount of memory required by an algorithm.

questions.questionText: Which function of modern operating systems involves managing hardware resources such as CPU, memory, and I/O devices?
questions.explanation: Device management is responsible for managing hardware resources.

questions.questionText: Person A sends a message to person B. While the message is transmitted; person C has gained access to the message. Which category of an attack is performed by person C?
questions.explanation: Interception refers to unauthorized access to a transmitted message.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not a reason for the need for backups?

questions.questionText: Indexes in database tables speed up the ______ operations.
questions.explanation: Indexes are primarily used to speed up read operations in databases.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not true about Inheritance?
options: The subclass can add variables, but cannot redefine them.
The derived class (subclass) is allowed to add methods or redefine them.
A feature that allows us to derive a class from another class.
Allows programmers to customize without actually modifying the original class (the superclass).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following terms refers to the techniques used for deciphering a cipher text without any knowledge of the enciphering mechanism involved?

questions.questionText: In C++, what does the cout object typically represent?
questions.explanation: The cout object is used for standard output in C++.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is an efficient top-down parser?

questions.questionText: When is the appropriate time to shut down a system?
questions.explanation: Systems should be shut down for maintenance and upgrades.

questions.questionText: Which data structure is used to store information about the source program constructs?
questions.explanation: A tree structure is commonly used to represent source program constructs.

questions.questionText: If a sequence of operations - push(1), push(2), pop, push(1), push(2), pop, pop, push(2), pop are performed on a stack, the sequence of popped out values are, _____.
questions.explanation: The sequence of operations results in the specified popped values.

questions.questionText: How are the objects organized in the HTML DOM?
questions.explanation: The HTML DOM organizes objects in a hierarchical structure.

questions.questionText: What is the role of a database administrator (DBA)?
options: Designing user interfaces for database applications.
questions.explanation: The DBA is responsible for managing and maintaining databases.

questions.questionText: The user who programs a computer in machine or assembly language must be aware of the following except _____.

questions.questionText: A module is said to have logical cohesion if:
options: All the functions of the module are executed within the same time span.
All elements of the module depend on their interface complexity.
It performs a set of tasks that relate to each other very loosely.
All elements of the module perform similar operations.

questions.questionText: What does the if-else statement allow you to do in C++?
options: Execute a block of code only if a condition is true, otherwise execute another block of code
Repeat a block of code multiple times
questions.explanation: The if-else statement controls the flow of execution based on conditions.

questions.questionText: What is the term for a named block of code that performs a specific task?

questions.questionText: Which OOP concept allows a class to implement multiple interfaces in Java?
questions.explanation: Polymorphism is the concept that allows a class to implement multiple interfaces in Java. It enables objects to take on multiple forms through interface implementation.

questions.questionText: A process is terminated by the operating system due to a reference to non-existing memory. Which one of the following best explains the process termination?
questions.explanation: A fatal exit occurs when a process attempts to access memory that doesn't exist (segmentation fault). This is a severe error that forces the OS to terminate the process.

questions.questionText: Size of large data files can be reduced to save storage disk space. Which algorithm is appropriate to reduce size of large files?
questions.explanation: Huffman encoding is a lossless data compression algorithm that uses variable-length codes to represent data, with more frequent data items getting shorter codes, thus reducing overall file size.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is asynchronous in message communication?
questions.explanation: Non-blocking receive is asynchronous because the receiver doesn't wait for the message to arrive - it can continue processing and check for messages later.

There is no limit to the number of function parameters that a function may contain

questions.questionText: Suppose you have received a message from your friend but the message is scrambled for the sake of security. Your friend has used a program to encode messages into scrambled text. In order to read the message which program would you use?
questions.explanation: A decryption program is needed to reverse the encryption process and convert the scrambled message (ciphertext) back to its original form.

questions.questionText: In a tree data structure, if a node has no parent node, then the node is ______.
questions.explanation: The root node is the only node in a tree that has no parent. All other nodes have exactly one parent (except in graphs).

questions.questionText: Which statement is true about pop() operation of Stack data structures?

pop() returns the end/top element but it doesn't delete that element
pop() removes the end/top element from stack
pop() inserts new element at the beginning/bottom of stack

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not correct about transaction failure?

Transactions fail if logical errors are detected
Transactions fail if disk blocks lose their data
Catastrophes can be cause of transaction failure
questions.explanation:
Concurrency control prevents interference between transactions but doesn't prevent all types of failures.
Transactions can fail due to logical errors (b), disk failures (c), and catastrophes (d).

questions.questionText: Which asymptotic notation describes average case analysis?

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not an example of scripting languages?

questions.questionText: What will be the output of the following JavaScript statement? Math.sqrt(36)
questions.explanation: Math.sqrt() calculates the square root, so Math.sqrt(36) returns 6 (since 6 × 6 = 36).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is false about project planning stage?
options: Project planning is a one-time task in software development life cycle
Risk analysis is done during project planning
Cost estimation is done during project planning
Preparing time schedule is done during project planning
questions.explanation: Project planning is an ongoing activity throughout the SDLC, not a one-time task. The other options correctly describe activities in project planning.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is different from the other based on its role in computer network?
questions.explanation: Network printer is an end device that uses the network, while routers, hubs, and WAPs are all network infrastructure devices that facilitate communication.

questions.questionText: Advancement of operating system is closely tied to computer architectures, therefore, has passed through different generations. Which one of the following generation and advancement is wrongly coupled?
questions.explanation:
Third generation saw time-sharing systems, not batch systems (which were first generation).
Other couplings are correct: 4th-gen had real-time, 1st-gen was single user, 2nd-gen introduced multiprogramming.

questions.questionText: ______ is a network architecture characteristic that states a network can expand quickly to address needs of new users and application without having impact on the services delivered to existing users.
questions.explanation: Scalability refers to a system's ability to handle growth by adding resources without degrading performance for existing users.

questions.questionText: Look at the following PHP line: $list = array(20, 12, 23, 19, 18); What is the index of data value 19?
questions.explanation: PHP arrays are zero-indexed. The value 19 is at index 3 (positions: 0=20, 1=12, 2=23, 3=19, 4=18).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following algorithms can be used to extract Minimum Spanning Tree from an input graph?
questions.explanation:
Prim's algorithm is specifically designed to find a minimum spanning tree (MST).
Dijkstra's finds shortest paths, Merge sort is for sorting, and Huffman encoding is for compression.

questions.questionText: ______ is set of attributes that can be seen by a program and can have direct impact on the logical execution of a program.
questions.explanation:
Architecture refers to the programmer-visible aspects of a system that affect program execution (instruction set, registers, etc.).
Organization refers to internal implementation details not visible to programmers.

questions.questionText: Which quantifier can be used for some portion of the universe?
questions.explanation:
The existential quantifier (∃) means "there exists" or "for some", while universal quantifier (∀) means "for all".
The other symbols are not standard quantifiers.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not true about fan trap in Entity Relationship Diagram?
options: It can be resolved by readjusting the model so that no one-to-many relationships fan out from an entity
It occurs when there is no pathway between related entities
When there is ambiguous pathway between some entity occurrences in related entity types
Highly likely exit when more than two one-to-many relationships fan out from an entity
questions.explanation:
A fan trap occurs when there ARE pathways but they're ambiguous (not when there's no pathway).
It happens when multiple 1:M relationships fan out from a single entity, potentially causing misinterpretation.

questions.questionText: Assume you have a universe of Key U. Which one is false statement regarding Direct Address table and Hash Table data structures?

Hash table allocates one separate memory slot for each key in the universe U
There is one to one correspondence between keys in the universe U and memory slots in the Direct Address table
Direct Address table doesn't use hash function to map keys

Other options are true: hash tables are better for large U (a), direct address has 1:1 mapping (c), and doesn't use hashing (d).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a two-level cache having an internal and external caches?

Split cache divides L1 into instruction and data caches, while unified cache combines them.

BFS uses a queue, while priority queues are used in algorithms like Dijkstra's.

questions.explanation:
ping tests basic connectivity by sending ICMP echo requests.
nslookup queries DNS, traceroute shows path, and DHCP discover is for obtaining IP addresses.

options: There are more features in javascript than java
Javascript can be used in extremely sophisticated applications
Javascript is compiled and interpreted in source code form
questions.explanation:
Modern JavaScript can power complex applications (e.g., Node.js, React).
Java is OOP but JavaScript is prototype-based (a), Java has more features (b), and JavaScript is interpreted (d).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not a single level ordered index?
questions.explanation:
Multilevel index is hierarchical with multiple levels (not single level).
Primary, secondary, and clustering indexes are all single-level index types.

questions.questionText: Suppose you have developed a self-driving car equipped with relevant sensors and camera that helps it to see the road and drive sensing traffic lights, pedestrians and signs. Its sensors are able to detect the environment but not all the aspects. Hence, in which environment is your car acting?
questions.explanation:
Since sensors can't detect all aspects (e.g., occluded objects), it's partially observable.

questions.questionText: Which network security issue shows the level of weakness in networks and devices?
questions.explanation:
Vulnerability refers to weaknesses that could be exploited.
Threat is potential danger, attack is the actual exploitation, and availability is a security goal.

questions.questionText: Assume there is a line of patients waiting for a service from a clinic. Seriously sick patients should get service first. Which data structure is the most appropriate for the given type of real world problem?
questions.explanation:
Priority queue handles items with different priorities (serious patients first).
Regular queue is FIFO, stack is LIFO, and tree isn't suitable for this ordering scenario.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a measure taken, to ensure information and information systems' availability, integrity, authentication and confidentiality?
questions.explanation: Information assurance is a comprehensive approach that encompasses all aspects of information security (confidentiality, integrity, availability) plus additional measures like authentication, non-repudiation, and system reliability. questions.questionText: Which type of Turing machine has two tapes, one tape read-only and the other read-write tape?

questions.questionText: Which branch of study deals with whether a problem can be solved at all or not, regardless of the resources required?
questions.explanation:

questions.questionText: At which layer of the OSI model devices such as bridges, switches and Network interface cards are used?
questions.explanation:

Routers are Layer 3 (Network), while hubs are Layer 1 (Physical).

It is a lost update problem
It is a temporary read problem

Immediate update writes changes as they occur, while shadowing maintains old versions until commit.

options: Assembly language should be translated to machine language before execution
Fifth generation programming languages need very powerful hardware and software
Machine language can be executed without translation

questions.questionText: If you plan a software test to be done by clients to demonstrate that the system satisfies their requirements, which phase of software testing is appropriate?
questions.explanation:
Acceptance testing is performed by clients to verify requirements.
Unit tests individual components, integration tests interactions, and system tests the complete system.

questions.questionText: Which concept refers to extending specialized classes from generalized classes in object-oriented programming?
questions.explanation:
Inheritance allows creating specialized (child) classes from generalized (parent) classes.
Overloading is same name different parameters, overriding is redefining parent methods, encapsulation is data hiding.

questions.questionText: What does the program data independence in the database approach entails for?
options: Both program and data are defined together
The application may be affected when data changes
Programs can create redundant data independently
Data and applications are defined separately
questions.explanation: Program-data independence means that the data and applications are defined separately, allowing changes to data definitions without affecting application programs.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following computers can be most secured compared to the rest?

computer connected to the Internet with the latest firewall system
computer connected to the Internet having strong intrusion detection

questions.questionText: Which type of variable can be accessed through out our C++ program scope?

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not correct about computer architecture and organization?
options: An architecture can be used for long time encompassing different computer models
Manufacturers offer computer with same architecture but different organization
An organization can last for long time as an architecture does
An architecture can remain for long time but its organization can change

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is correct for the statement below? questions.questionText: Which one of the following is evaluating the degrees of success of an agent?
